# <notes>

> A notes app that doesn't get in the way of thinking: one hub for your work — write Markdown, dictate by voice, set tasks. The site is under construction.

Languages: Russian (default), English, Serbian — https://notes.makark.ru/?lang=ru, ?lang=en, ?lang=sr

## Features

- Markdown files in your folder: every note is a plain .md file; pick any folder and the app starts working.
- Tasks in your calendar: add a date to a task in a note and it shows up in Apple Calendar, no separate planning apps.
- Smart search: find a note even if you don't remember the exact words; semantic search understands context.
- Dictation: press a hotkey in any app and speech turns into text; transcripts with timestamps and speaker names; runs locally.
- Templates: create note templates to speed up your work.
- GitHub: the folder keeps the full change history, restore any edit; GitHub connects if you want.

## Other

- Quick notes, folders, search, file sync, dark theme.
- Pages: https://notes.makark.ru/

## На русском

<notes> — приложение для заметок, которое не мешает думать: markdown-файлы в вашей папке, задачи в календаре, умный поиск, локальная диктовка, шаблоны, история изменений через github.
